bugs_found: transfer allows overdraft up to 0.01 because insufficient-balance check uses amount - Decimal('0.01')
transfer is not atomic: account_from is debited before account_to credit can fail, leaving inconsistent balances
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, so floats/strings/NaN can raise unexpected errors or corrupt arithmetic
compound_interest silently truncates non-integer years and compounds_per_year via int()
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months via int()
fx_convert accepts zero/negative/non-finite FX rates, allowing zero or negative converted amounts
money functions do not quantize/round to currency minor units, causing precision/scale drift in balances and payments
missing finite-value validation across Decimal inputs allows NaN/Infinity edge cases to escape intended checks
